description: Swap BTC through Satora: Lightning or Arkade into USDC or USDT0 on Arbitrum, or Lightning ↔ Arkade. Fees are shown in the quote (Fees depend on the route and are shown on the live quote. Lightning or Arkade to USDC or USDT0 (and back) is about 1% total (Satora ~0.5% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Lightning to Arkade is about 0.65% total (Satora ~0.15% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee. Arkade to Lightning is about 0.80% total (Satora ~0.30% + Agent Escrow 0.5%) plus network fee). REAL MONEY on mainnet. Without confirm: preview only. With confirm: creates the swap and returns what to pay once (a Lightning invoice, an Ark address + exact sats, or both for the rail). After paying a Lightning- or Arkade-to-stablecoin swap, or a Lightning-to-Arkade swap, call swap_claim with wait=true. After paying an Arkade-to-Lightning swap, call swap_status (or swap_claim with wait=true) to wait for Satora to pay the invoice; there is nothing for you to claim. Non-custodial: the claim key stays in this Mark home

address.description: payout destination: 0x on Arbitrum (to a stablecoin) or an Ark address on https://arkade.computer (to arkade)

confirm.description: must be true to create the real swap; omit to preview

from.description: where the BTC comes from (default lightning)

invoice.description: from arkade to lightning: a BOLT11 invoice with an amount

sats.description: sats to send (required for BTC → stablecoin and Lightning → Arkade; omit when an invoice pins an Arkade → Lightning payout)

to.description: stablecoin on Arbitrum (default usdc), or lightning/arkade for a Lightning ↔ Arkade swap

name: swap_create
